details: Malicious package. `index.js` uses PowerShell `Invoke-WebRequest` to download `RobloxPlayerLauncher.exe` and `cmd.exe` from https://github.com/zvydev/code/raw/main/ into the package directory and launches them with `Start-Process`: a Windows executable dropper themed around Roblox tooling. In a sandboxed install the hook issued both downloads. Same downloader URLs as the sibling package rolimons-api.
